verdict.rationale: Amplitude offers pieces that resemble autonomous background automation—flag rollout/rollback rules that react to data (amplitude-docs-19), automated in-product guides/surveys triggers (amplitude-docs-14), CI/script-driven experiment management (amplitude-docs-13), and an embeddable agent that 'completes tasks for users' (amplitude-docs-26)—but there is no dedicated, documented automation/workflow builder explicitly for AI-native users to configure and run persistent background automations. missing for 10: a first-party 'automations' or workflow engine with triggers/schedules, independent evidence of autonomous background execution, and confirmation the embedded agent runs unattended rather than on-demand.
